comments.body: I was seeing this error as well, using 0abbdd064846817e97ca751d1c7ee5f4a933789c (see https://github.com/google/jax/issues/11972) made the problem go away!
Closing this because I _think_ it's effectively a duplicate of #11972. Please reopen/complain if I am wrong!
@UwUeeb I wasn't able to repro this on a CUDA cloud machine. Is this a rocm-specific issue? Do you think #11972 is related?
Assigning to @UwUeeb to follow up with more info.
Hi sorry i have changed my workstation along with that i have shifted from ROCM to CUDA so cant get more info about this issue , sorry for that
@mattjj hi im back on a rocm platform, and i guess i have the patch for the issue, if this is still a problem i can create a PR
I'm guessing this issue is stale. Please let us know if I'm wrong and there's still something for us to do here.
